items.title: Crawford and Slater confirmed for Mexico City FP1
items.summary: Jak Crawford will drive Lance Stroll's Aston Martin AMR26 in Mexico City FP1, his fourth appearance this year. The article says it completes the team's mandated rookie sessions for the year. Audi development driver Freddie Slater will also make his first F1 weekend appearance in FP1 in Mexico City and Sao Paulo.
items.why_it_matters: Both cars lose a regular driver's FP1 running, which affects early-session comparisons. Slater's race-weekend debut is a new storyline.
